question.text: The Offshore Fund in an Offshore Structure is typically domiciled in:

answer.text: Tax-friendly jurisdictions like Mauritius, Singapore, Luxembourg

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (p.74), an offshore fund structure uses an offshore pooling vehicle domiciled in jurisdictions such as Mauritius or Singapore. Page 76 reinforces that the offshore fund is located in tax-friendly foreign jurisdictions such as Singapore, Mauritius, and Luxembourg. The Trap: India is the onshore jurisdiction; restricting the offshore vehicle to only the USA or only the UK is too narrow and is not what the workbook describes. Note: Other tax-context material on Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS), Foreign Portfolio Investor (FPI) routes, and Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements (DTAA) is covered separately in the tax chapter and is not required to support the domicile point above.
